observations: Bonfires divide traversal and recovery through an interconnected hostile world.
Death repeats a route with recoverable value exposed to further loss.
Enemy placement and route knowledge let a later attempt become faster or safer without removing execution.
inferences: Checkpoint distance is part of encounter structure because it sets the amount of solved material repeated before the failed point.
Recoverable loss can create a new route decision, but only while recovery remains realistically possible.
limits: The product page does not specify every death and recovery edge case.
Claims about learning require direct build observation and player reports.
